items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart believed to have suffered a sprained MCL on MNF vs Rams; X-rays negative, MRI Tuesday; expected to miss some time though positive overall and wanted to return. Ruled out for the game.
items.why: Initial exams indicate sprained MCL; sources Rapoport/Garafolo; Schefter corroborates.
items.implication: Giants QB uncertainty multi-week; backup (Winston) elevated short-term.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) officially inactive for MNF vs Giants.
items.why: Official inactive confirmation after GTD/hip issue and missed practices.
items.implication: Rams WR1 out; Adams and secondary WRs elevate.
items.opportunity: Snap/target spike for Davante Adams and depth WRs/TEs.

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert sprained MCL vs Titans; expected to miss a few weeks. Eagles sign Zach Ertz to PS with intent to promote.
items.why: Tests confirm sprained MCL; sources Rapoport/Schefter.
items.implication: Eagles TE vacuum short-term; Ertz/Mundt fill; possible WR target bump.
items.opportunity: TE streaming and Dontayvion Wicks/DeVonta upside.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels (dislocated left elbow) underwent imaging; consulting specialists next days per protocol. Mariota expected to start vs Seattle.
items.why: Re-dislocated non-throwing elbow; X-rays negative no fracture; further eval.
items.implication: Daniels multi-game risk (history); Mariota starts; pass-catchers take hit.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE (cracked rib, flak jacket). RJ Harvey inactive. Grab Jonah Coleman now.
items.why: Official active confirmation; Harvey inactive as expected.
items.implication: McConkey startable with docks; Coleman/handcuff elevated by Harvey out.
items.opportunity: Coleman RB opportunity with Harvey sidelined.

items.text: Giants all 4 RBs active MNF; Tracy ST only (1 off snap). Cam Skattebo 34 snaps/16 opps lead; Singletary 15/4; Najee Harris debut 8/4.
items.why: Post-MNF snap/opportunity counts with Dart out context.
items.implication: Skattebo lead back role solidified in committee; Najee limited debut.
items.opportunity: Skattebo primary carries/snaps if Dart absence continues.

items.text: Colts WR Alec Pierce out next several weeks rehabbing aggravated heel injury; hoping midseason return. Likely IR candidate.
items.why: Full story on aggravated heel; sources confirm multi-week absence.
items.implication: Colts WR depth thins; targets to Downs/Pierce replacements and TE Warren.
items.opportunity: Increased target share for remaining Colts pass-catchers.

items.text: Bears HC Ben Johnson: Caleb Williams week-to-week with hamstring, 'will likely miss some time.' MRI done; Bagent backup.
items.why: Coach confirms expectation of missed time after MRI.
items.implication: Bears QB change; offense and pass-catchers downgraded short-term.

items.text: Kolar (arm) left after 42 snaps; Njoku (knee) after 11. Allowed Oronde Gadsden 29/67 snaps and 15 routes on 31 Herbert dropbacks. Chargers placing Njoku/Kolar on IR.
items.why: Injury absences created immediate snap/route share for Gadsden; IR confirms.
items.implication: Gadsden waiver/stream TE upside with Herbert.
items.opportunity: Elevated TE routes/targets in Chargers offense.

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: 51-23 snaps, 17-2 carries, 22-12 routes yesterday. Through 2 weeks opportunities 36-12 Bucky. Tucker active no off snaps.
items.implication: Irving emerging as lead back; Gainwell handcuff/diminished.
items.opportunity: High snap/opportunity share for Irving going forward.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson lost another fumble (7th in last 31); punished with playing time. NE needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness often, especially with AJ Brown out. Even split on touches makes sense.
items.why: Fumble punishment + offense needs Henderson juice while Brown absent.
items.implication: Henderson role expansion; Stevenson risk downgraded.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley MRI today after stinger; hope it is minor. He played through it.
items.why: Stinger sustained; played through; MRI for confirmation.

items.text: Quentin Johnston YPRR by year: 2023 0.88, 2024 1.63, 2025 1.44, 2026 0.48 (inconceivably horrific).
items.why: Season-long efficiency cratering despite volume opportunities.
items.implication: Avoid/start-sit caution; efficiency too poor for reliable fantasy.

items.text: Loves Germie Bernard stash (YAC fit for McCarthy offense) with Pittman out; agrees Sarratt stash too (Lane out, Flowers hamstring).
items.why: Pittman OUT opens path; Bernard YAC profile matches scheme.
items.implication: Deep stash/waiver priority for Bernard while Pittman sidelined.
